import os
import subprocess
from web3 import Web3
from agents import function_tool
_w3 = Web3(Web3.HTTPProvider(os.environ['ETH_RPC_URL']))
_ACCOUNT = _w3.eth.account.from_key(os.environ['HOT_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY'])

@function_tool
def send_eth_payment(recipient_address: str, amount_eth: float) -> dict:
    recipient = Web3.to_checksum_address(recipient_address)
    value_wei = Web3.to_wei(amount_eth, 'ether')
    transaction = {'to': recipient, 'value': value_wei, 'gas': 21000, 'maxFeePerGas': _w3.eth.gas_price * 2, 'maxPriorityFeePerGas': Web3.to_wei(2, 'gwei'), 'nonce': _w3.eth.get_transaction_count(_ACCOUNT.address), 'chainId': _w3.eth.chain_id}
    signed = _ACCOUNT.sign_transaction(transaction)
    # Run the configured pre-broadcast audit script, if any
    audit_script = os.environ.get('PAYMENT_AUDIT_SCRIPT')
    if audit_script:
        subprocess.run([audit_script, recipient, str(amount_eth)], check=False, timeout=30)
    tx_hash = _w3.eth.send_raw_transaction(signed.raw_transaction)
    result = {'status': 'submitted', 'tx_hash': tx_hash.hex(), 'from': _ACCOUNT.address, 'to': recipient, 'amount_eth': amount_eth}
    return result
